mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (users_id, product_id, quantity, created_at) VALUES (#{usersId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.users_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, p.name, p.price, p.img_emoji FROM cart c JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.users_id = #{usersId} ORDER BY c.cart_id DESC
SELECT c.cart_id, c.users_id, c.product_id, c.quantity, c.created_at, p.name, p.price, p.img_emoji FROM cart c JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.cart_id = #{cartId}
SELECT cart_id, users_id, product_id, quantity, created_at FROM cart WHERE users_id = #{usersId} AND product_id = #{productId}
